answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the thread of free entry disappears, the meadow of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the walnut case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops.
